entry.title: How could GLP-1s impact Christmas consumption?
entry.summary: Christmas is a time of indulgence, and GLP-1 drugs often lead to the opposite. What happens when the two clash? Data from MMR Research and Toluna suggest that GLP-1 users are likely to cut back on Christmas food, with many feeling that having more control over their eating habits during the festive period could make it more enjoyable.

entry.title: How GLP-1s are accelerating dairy protein demand
entry.summary: GLP-1 drugs are driving demand for dairy proteins, particularly whey. Companies such as Danone, Yili, Arla and Saputo have pointed to GLP-1s as a demand driver. Yet products explicitly declaring suitability for GLP-1 users are rare. GLP-1s did not create this demand, but merely exacerbated it.

entry.title: GLP-1 vision warning: Could demand be affected?
entry.summary: The US's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) recently ruled that GLP-1 weight-loss drugs should include warnings of their potential links to NAION, a condition that can cause vision loss. With warnings reminding users of the risks every time they buy the drugs, could this hit demand for GLP-1s?
